title: seseli elatum subsp. gouanii
intro: Seseli elatum subsp. gouanii, commonly known as Goat's rue or Gouan's Seseli, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various gastrointestinal issues, such as indigestion and bloating, due to its carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Seseli elatum subsp. gouanii are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles in the digestive tract and its anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include essential oils, flavonoids, and coumarins.
